caption:
At some point we all decided being knackered was just who we are.

The Bupa Wellbeing Index 2026 found 57% of UK workers keep working when they're exhausted, and 56% have put off getting help to avoid time off.

Number 7 comes first for me. Tiredness that doesn't lift is worth a blood test. The other six are what I do while I find out whether it's just December.

What time of day do you hit the wall?

Save this for your next 3pm slump, and send it to the friend who says "I'm just tired" every time you ask.

#EnergyBoost #TiredAllTheTime #WorkLifeUK #HealthyHabitsUK #UKWellness
